observable_indistinguishability_class.description: Classification of states that are indistinguishable from the perspective of observable metrics.

classes.name: metric_equivalent_states
classes.description: Distinct state vectors X1, X2 such that Metrics(X1) = Metrics(X2).
classes.example: Different residue distributions yielding the same residue_mean.

classes.name: continuation_equivalent_preimages
classes.description: Distinct preimages that produce identical admissible forward continuation.
classes.example: States yielding the same unique selection for delta.

classes.name: boundary_clipped_equivalent
classes.description: States differing only in components clipped by the Pi_A window.

indistinguishability_risks.description: Xi may attribute an observable to the wrong causal preimage history.
Indistinguishable states may have different long-term recursive stability properties.
